The recurring payments would each require their own assessment, particularly regarding the donor tax-paid condition (a3) and Gift Aid declaration coverage (a4)."],"limitations":["E11 refers to a benefit limit 'over a certain limit' but does not specify the monetary threshold; the passages do not supply the benefit-in-kind limits needed to evaluate a4 precisely.","The passages do not specify the exact amount that can be reclaimed per donation beyond the illustrative 25p per £1 example in E01; the precise claim amount relevant to the tax-paid comparison in a3 is not defined in the supplied material.","The passages do not address what formal requirements a Gift Aid declaration must satisfy (e.g. duration, coverage of past or future gifts, required fields) beyond the existence of permission; adequacy of a partial or ambiguous declaration cannot be assessed from the supplied text alone.","The passages do not address rules around record-keeping or evidence standards required to support a Gift Aid claim, so whether incomplete documentation disqualifies an otherwise valid claim is outside the scope of the supplied material."]}
